t: The Mac Allister aluminium 6-step platform step ladder provides a secure and stable elevated working platform for professional use. This aluminium stepladder is ideal for various trade tasks on job sites, such as painting and decorating or accessing high-level storage. Constructed from lightweight aluminium making it easy to transport and position. It features a platform with slip-resistant flat treads for stability and user safety. Designed for reliability, this robust platform ladder supports a maximum static vertical load of 150kg.
